text: My daily routine is quite simple, but I follow it carefully. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and some stretching. After a quick breakfast, I check my emails and plan the day ahead. I begin work at nine and stay focused until lunchtime. In the afternoon, I try to exercise for about thirty minutes, either by walking or doing a short workout at home. In the evening, I cook dinner, read a book, or watch a series with my family. I go to bed before eleven because staying consistent helps me feel energetic and organized every day.
